evidence_basis: Ma et al. 2025 PLOS Biology (PMID 41066510, DOI 10.1371/journal.pbio.3003192, open access): the complete article as the publisher JATS XML (abstract, introduction, Results, Discussion, Methods, all figure legends and supporting-information legends); figure images not viewed. GEO series GSE292221 and GSE292102 by record page and file listing only.
